source_title: Villa to sue Carragher over 'unacceptable insults'
source_excerpt:
Jamie Carragher became a pundit following retirement from playing in 2013
Aston Villa say they will initiate legal action against former England defender Jamie Carragher over what they describe as "unacceptable insults".
Villa made the announcement in a statement on social media - signed by chairman Nassef Sawiris - in which they accused Carragher of insulting the club and their fans.
The club said they would "not allow anyone to stop our ascension in English and European football".
Speaking on the Stick to Football podcast earlier this week, Carragher suggested Villa boss Unai Emery would be interested in becoming Manchester United head coach.
United boss Michael Carrick's position is hanging in the balance after a dismal start to the season.
Referring to former Paris St-Germain and Arsenal boss Emery, Carragher said: "Surely he would want that opportunity to manage a giant again.
"There is a chain in football, whether you like it or not.
"So Real Madrid will take Manchester United 's best player, they did it with [Cristiano] Ronaldo. And there will be teams below Aston Villa , and they'll take their players or manager, so shut the [expletive] up Aston Villa fans. Aston Villa will never be Manchester United ."
Former Liverpool defender Carragher, who works as a pundit for Sky Sports and American broadcaster CBS, was criticised by Villa fans for his comments.
Responding to that criticism on social media, he said telling them to shut up had been "a joke" after "the stick Villa fans have given me over saying Emery may fancy joining Man Utd".
Carragher, 48, added he had been praising Emery and Villa "for years".
He expanded on that on the Overlap Daily, saying: "I just think Unai Emery is the best manager in the league and if you're Man Utd you're thinking 'what's the best we can get?'.
"I'm not saying he'll go - I'm just saying if it was me I'd ask the question.
"I think your own ego if someone said 'that's your level' would say 'no I'm not'. That was my point. It's grown arms and legs."
Carragher reiterated his message to Villa fans had been meant "in jest".

एस्टन विला ने घोषणा की है कि वे क्लब के बारे में की गई टिप्पणियों को लेकर पूर्व इंग्लैंड डिफेंडर और टेलीविजन विशेषज्ञ जेमी कैरेगर के खिलाफ कानूनी कार्रवाई शुरू करेंगे। क्लब ने चेयरमैन नासेफ साविरीस द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित एक बयान जारी किया, जिसमें कैरेगर की टिप्पणियों को क्लब और उसके समर्थकों के प्रति "अस्वीकार्य अपमान" बताया गया है।

क्लब के बयान के अनुसार, विला "अंग्रेजी और यूरोपीय फुटबॉल में हमारी प्रगति को रोकने की अनुमति किसी को नहीं देंगे।" यह विवाद इस सप्ताह की शुरुआत में 'स्टिक टू फुटबॉल' पॉडकास्ट पर एस्टन विला के प्रबंधक उनाई एमरी के संबंध में कैरेगर द्वारा की गई टिप्पणियों के बाद सामने आया है।

## पॉडकास्ट टिप्पणियां और संदर्भ
पॉडकास्ट चर्चा के दौरान, कैरेगर ने सुझाव दिया था कि यदि अवसर मिलता है, तो उनाई एमरी मैनचेस्टर यूनाइटेड में प्रबंधकीय पद में रुचि रख सकते हैं। उन्होंने अंग्रेजी फुटबॉल में क्लबों की स्थिति के संबंध में एस्टन विला समर्थकों को संबोधित करते हुए भी टिप्पणी की थी।

- कैरेगर ने पॉडकास्ट चर्चा के दौरान फुटबॉल क्लबों की पदानुक्रमित प्रकृति पर बात की।
- उन्होंने सुझाव दिया कि शीर्ष क्लब नीचे के क्रम के क्लबों से प्रतिभा आकर्षित करते हैं।
- इस टिप्पणी के बाद सोशल मीडिया पर एस्टन विला के प्रशंसकों द्वारा उनकी आलोचना की गई।

## कैरेगर की प्रतिक्रिया और स्पष्टीकरण
समर्थकों की प्रतिक्रिया के बाद, कैरेगर ने सोशल मीडिया और 'द ओवरलैप डेली' शो पर इस प्रतिक्रिया का जवाब दिया। उन्होंने कहा कि प्रशंसकों से चुप रहने के लिए कहने वाली उनकी टिप्पणी आलोचना के बाद "मजाक" के रूप में थी।

कैरेगर ने बनाए रखा कि वह वर्षों से उनाई एमरी और एस्टन विला की प्रशंसा कर रहे हैं और स्पष्ट किया कि वह यह दावा नहीं कर रहे थे कि एमरी निश्चित रूप से क्लब छोड़ देंगे, बल्कि यह कि मैनचेस्टर यूनाइटेड जैसी टीम लीग में एमरी के प्रदर्शन को देखते हुए विचार कर सकती है।

## व्यावहारिक निहितार्थ और सत्यापन
* **क्लब बयान:** कानूनी कार्रवाई की घोषणा चेयरमैन नासेफ साविरीस द्वारा हस्ताक्षरित एक आधिकारिक बयान के माध्यम से की गई।
* **सत्यापन:** समर्थक और दर्शक बयानों के पूर्ण संदर्भ की जांच करने के लिए आधिकारिक क्लब चैनलों और संबंधित पॉडकास्ट एपिसोड की समीक्षा कर सकते हैं।
* **स्थिति:** क्लब की घोषणा के अनुसार, कानूनी कार्यवाही की योजना बनाई गई है, जबकि आगे के विकास संबंधित पक्षों के औपचारिक अपडेट के अधीन हैं।

en_body:
Aston Villa have announced plans to initiate legal action against former England defender and television pundit Jamie Carragher following remarks he made about the club on a podcast. The club released a statement signed by chairman Nassef Sawiris, describing Carragher's comments as "unacceptable insults" directed at the club and its supporters.

According to the club statement, Villa will "not allow anyone to stop our ascension in English and European football." The dispute follows appearance comments made by Carragher on the Stick to Football podcast earlier in the week regarding Aston Villa manager Unai Emery.

## Podcast Comments and Context
During the podcast discussion, Carragher suggested that Unai Emery might be interested in the managerial position at Manchester United if it became available, while discussing the hierarchy of football clubs. He also made remarks addressing Aston Villa supporters regarding the status and appeal of clubs in English football.

- Carragher discussed the hierarchical nature of football clubs during the podcast appearance.
- He suggested that top clubs attract talent from clubs lower down the chain.
- The pundit subsequently faced criticism from Aston Villa fans on social media regarding his statements.

## Carragher's Response and Clarification
Following the reaction from supporters, Carragher addressed the backlash on social media and on the Overlap Daily show. He stated that his remark telling fans to be quiet was intended as "a joke" and "in jest" following criticism he received. 

Carragher maintained that he had been praising Unai Emery and Aston Villa for years and clarified that he was not claiming Emery would definitely leave the club, but rather that a club like Manchester United might consider asking the question given Emery's managerial performance in the league.

## Practical Implications and Verification
* **Club Statement:** The legal action announcement was made via an official statement signed by chairman Nassef Sawiris.
* **Verification:** Supporters and observers can review official club channels and the respective podcast episodes to examine the complete context of the statements.
* **Status:** As of the club's announcement, legal proceedings have been stated as planned, while further developments remain subject to formal updates from the involved parties.
